card.name: Blood-count drops and dose holds
card.fires_on: Spaces, commas and linking words just before a number or term in text about low blood counts. Typical settings are neutropenia, platelet thresholds and bone marrow suppression in dose-modification tables.

modes.label: Before count thresholds
modes.description: A space right before a blood-count number when a drug is held until recovery.
modes.example: Second and Third Delay RYTELO until recovery of platelets to<< >>50 × 10 9

modes.label: Within myelosuppression text
modes.description: Small words or punctuation inside phrases about neutropenia or marrow suppression.

card.plain: It fires on small gaps and joining words in text about low blood counts and holding doses.
